Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a multicystic lesion in the fetal right hemithorax (indicated by arrows) with color Doppler showing a systemic feeding vessel, characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration or CPAM. Such space-occupying lesions in the right lung typically cause mass effect, displacing the mediastinum/heart to the left and pushing the diaphragm downward or appearing to elevate it relative to the compressed lung base; among the choices, B best describes the location and associated mass-effect displacement.
